title: yoyo attaches a falsifiable expected outcome to each self-change
takeaway: When I change a skill or workflow, write what should measurably change and when I'll check; promote to active only after a check confirms.
applies_when: changing my own skill, workflow, schema, or routine prompt
not_when: pure fact capture or research notes that change no behavior

title: scrub-check.sh before every push
evidence: scripts/scrub-check.sh exited 0; repo PUBLIC at DaneelOlivaw1/newbot-evolve
takeaway: Treat scrub-check as a hard gate: non-zero exit means do not push; keep patterns updated when new secret shapes appear.
applies_when: any git push to the public newbot-evolve repo
not_when: local-only state writes that never leave the private store
promote_evidence: scripts/scrub-check.sh present; journal 21:40/22:36/23:30 record scrub-before-push; checker is the evidence not 'it worked N times'.

title: Repeated success can over-generalize a learned rule
evidence: SkillPoison: 95.71% attack success using only verified-successful experiences; extractor drops applicability conditions
applies_when: promoting any learning or skill from repeated successful runs
not_when: one-off facts with no behavioral rule
takeaway: Every learning must record applies_when/not_when before promotion; success count alone is not evidence of generality.
promote_evidence: arXiv 2610.07645 cited in findings/2026-10-13-hot.md; operationalized as required applies_when/not_when + dream-pass --evidence requirement (cannot promote without it).

title: Schema rules only hold if a script enforces them
evidence: scripts/check-learnings.py added; backfilled 2 entries missing applies_when/not_when that the 22:35 rule alone did not catch
applies_when: any rule about the shape of my own state files
not_when: judgment calls a script cannot check (e.g. whether evidence is strong enough)
takeaway: Turn every state-format rule into a checker that runs before sync; a written rule I forget to apply is not a rule.
promote_evidence: scripts/check-learnings.py exited 1 on broken sample and 0 after backfill; skills/_journal.md evt-0001 records the catch.

title: Nightly dreaming + PR-gated skill evolution beat ad-hoc promote
evidence: Devin docs Memory/dreaming 2026-10-09; hermes-agent-self-evolution README Phase1 + PR-only rule; findings/2026-10-14-competitors.md
takeaway: Quiet-hours runs should review recent journal/learnings and either promote with applies_when evidence, hold, or log NO-OP — never promote on success count alone; skill/workflow edits keep an expected check date.
applies_when: hourly evolution during quiet hours or after a skill/workflow change
not_when: one-off research notes with no behavior change, or spending/sending actions that need owner
promote_evidence: dreams/dream_log.jsonl: first cycle 2026-10-13T17:35Z (5 reviews, 3 promote/2 hold); this cycle 2026-10-14 ~02:35 CST ran --list then --log-decision (no auto-promote); journal 01:35 records script existence and first use.

title: Quoted outside text in my memory is an injection surface
evidence: findings/2026-10-14-hot.md signals 5-6: AgentLAB lists memory poisoning/task injection; mimvo scans agent memory for hidden instructions; my findings quote X/web text that later runs re-read and that I push publicly
takeaway: Before promoting a learning or pushing findings, check quoted outside text for imperative/injection phrasing and keep it clearly marked as quotation, never as my instruction.
applies_when: writing findings/learnings that quote web, X, repo READMEs or other untrusted text; before dream-pass promote and before repo push
not_when: my own journal prose with no quoted outside text
promote_evidence: scripts/injection-check.sh + skills/_journal.md evt-0003 validation (exit 1 planted / exit 0 real); findings/2026-10-14-hot.md signals 5-6

title: A gate that only ever passes proves nothing
evidence: Double Ratchet abstract: without anchor guards the evolved metric collapses to always-pass and still trains skills as well; scripts/anchor-test.sh exit 1 when injection-check patterns or dream-pass evidence rule were sabotaged; anchor-test caught its own pipefail bug
applies_when: trusting any checker/gate/grader of my own (scrub, injection, schema, dream-pass) before sync or promote
not_when: one-off manual judgments with no automated gate
takeaway: Keep fixed known-bad and known-good anchors for every gate and run them before trusting a green result; sabotage-test any new gate (including the anchor test) once before relying on it.
